label: Roadmap
title: Built in phases,
note: These are planning phases, not dates. Each phase begins when the previous one has produced its evidence.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.body: Company basics, working practices and first subsystem results.

phases.title: Platform and link
phases.body: Validate the aerial platform, demonstrate communications and telemetry, set navigation and sensing baselines.

phases.title: Networked nodes
phases.body: Connect multiple nodes in controlled tests and prove health monitoring and recovery.

phases.title: Missions with users
phases.body: Work with real users to define and demonstrate specific civilian and defence uses.

phases.title: Scale
phases.body: Viable offerings, supply and production processes, and a team that can keep building.
